title: Gully, older
logline: Gully on the dock in August, drawn whole for the first time in Vol. II: heavy, gray, the canvas jacket, a coffee, the ramp beside the steps. He's looking at the water. The strip's Gully at fifty-one.

panels.composition: Gully, heavy and gray, in the canvas jacket, standing at the dock's edge with a coffee, looking out at the August water. The plank ramp beside the shack steps behind him. Drawn whole: face, hands, the way he stands. The first full figure in the private pages.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a heavy gray-haired man in a canvas jacket standing at a dock's edge with a coffee looking out at summer water, a plank ramp beside shack steps behind him, drawn whole, no words
image.notes: The first full figure in Vol. II. Gully, not Wood.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Gully whole. The first face in the private pages.
